column1: # boru Language Specification: edge-quote-3 — macro edge cases
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Edge cases for the macro system beyond macro.tsv's basics: operands
# arrive as FORMS (never evaluated at capture), a form inserted twice
# EVALUATES twice, unquote inserts one node where splice spreads,
# auto-hygiene renames template binders (pinned by reading the
# caller's binding AFTER the call), macroexpand output is plain data,
# and the staging negatives are statically visible. Each row runs on
# a fresh registry, so gensym counters restart per row. See
# REFERENCE.md "Macros", design/MACROS.8.md.
def keep (macro [[x] [quote [77]]]) keep (1 div 0)
column3: a discarded paren operand NEVER evaluates — no division error

column1: def keep (macro [[x] [quote [77]]]) keep nosuchword
column3: a discarded bare word needs no binding — it was only a form

column1: def keep (macro [[x] [quote [77]]]) keep [1 div 0]
column3: a discarded list operand never evaluates either

column1: def keep (macro [[x] [quote [77]]]) keep {k: nosuch}
column3: a discarded map form never evaluates its values

column1: def m2 (macro [[x] [quote [unquote x]]]) m2 nosuchword
column3: …but INSERTING the form makes it real code at the call site

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) tw2 (2 mul 3)
column3: a paren form inserted twice runs twice: (2 mul 3)+(2 mul 3)

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) tw2 5
column3: the mission-classic expansion: 5 add 5

column1: def sub2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e sub unquote e]]]) sub2 4
column3: non-commutative body, same operand twice

column1: def dupx (macro [[x] [quote [unquote x unquote x]]]) dupx (gensym) eq
column3: the FORM is inserted twice, so gensym mints TWICE — never equal

column1: def dupx (macro [[x] [quote [unquote x unquote x]]]) dupx 9
column3: a literal form inserted twice is just the literal twice

column1: # --- §2 unquote inserts ONE node; splice SPREADS -------------------------
def one (macro [[x] [quote [unquote x]]]) one [1 2 3]
column3: unquote of a list form: the list arrives as one node

column1: def one (macro [[x] [quote [[unquote x]]]]) one [1 2 3]
column3: …wrapped again it nests, still one node

column1: def spr (macro [[xs] [quote [splice xs]]]) spr [1 2 3]
column3: splice spreads the list's elements into the sequence

column1: def spr (macro [[xs] [quote [[splice xs]]]]) spr [1 2 3]
column3: splice INSIDE a list literal rebuilds the list

column1: def spr (macro [[xs] [quote [splice xs]]]) spr [] 8
column3: an empty list splices to NOTHING — the expansion vanishes

column1: def mix (macro [[h xs] [quote [unquote h splice xs]]]) mix 0 [1 2]
column3: head as a node, tail spread, in template order

column1: def sum3 (macro [[xs] [quote [add splice xs]]]) sum3 [1 2]
column3: spread elements become the word's forward operands

column1: def rev2 (macro [[a b] [quote [unquote b unquote a]]]) rev2 1 2
column3: a macro can reorder its operand forms

column1: def lift (macro [[a b] [quote [[unquote a unquote b]]]]) lift 1 2
column3: …or wrap them into new structure

column1: def ev (macro [[x] [quote [unquote (1 add 2)]]]) ev 9
column3: a template-side (paren) evaluates at EXPANSION time; the operand is dropped

column1: # --- §3 hygiene: template binders are renamed ----------------------------
def tmp 42 def myor3 (macro [[a b] [quote [def tmp unquote a if tmp [tmp] [unquote b]]]]) myor3 false tmp tmp
column3: the template's `def tmp` is gensym'd — result AND the re-read caller tmp

column1: def tmp 7 def setm (macro [[v] [quote [def tmp unquote v tmp]]]) setm 99 tmp
column3: the macro's own tmp reads 99; the caller's tmp is untouched at 7

column1: def m (macro [[a] [ def t (gensym) quote [ def unquote t unquote a unquote t ] ]]) m 5
column3: hand-rolled hygiene: a gensym'd binder built in the macro body

column1: def zz 1 def shad (macro [[u] [quote [def zz 5 zz]]]) shad 0 zz
column3: a template binder shadowing a live user def is renamed — both survive

column1: def mkc (macro [[name val] [quote [def unquote name unquote val]]]) mkc kk 9 kk
column3: an unquote'd NAME is caller-origin: the binding is user-visible

column1: def mkc (macro [[name val] [quote [def unquote name unquote val]]]) mkc kk 9 def kk 10 kk
column3: …and behaves as an ordinary def afterwards (shadowable)

column1: [gensym] get 0
column3: a fresh registry's first gensym rides a container

column1: (gensym) eq (gensym)
column3: two mints never collide

column1: def g1 (gensym) g1 eq g1
column3: …but a BOUND mint equals itself

column1: typeof (gensym)
column3: a gensym is an ordinary atom

column1: [gensym gensym] size
column3: mints are plain values in containers

column1: # --- §4 macroexpand: the expansion as data -------------------------------
def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7)
column3: the expansion is a token list, not a result

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7) size
column3: …with three nodes

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7) typeof
column3: …and it is a plain List

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7) get 0
column3: a literal node reads back as data

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7) get 1
column3: the word node re-fires when pulled out bare

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 7) do
column3: the expansion is runnable data — do replays it

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) macroexpand (tw2 (2 mul 3))
column3: a paren operand rides the expansion as a raw paren node

column1: def sq (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e mul unquote e]]]) def gr (macro [[y] [quote [sq unquote y]]]) macroexpand (gr 4)
column3: macroexpand is recursive: the inner macro expands too

column1: def sq (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e mul unquote e]]]) def gr (macro [[y] [quote [sq unquote y]]]) gr 4
column3: …and the nested call runs to the same answer

column1: def sq (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e mul unquote e]]]) def gr (macro [[y] [quote [sq unquote y add 1]]]) gr 3
column3: an expansion mixing a nested macro call with literal tokens

column1: # --- §5 staging + shape negatives (statically visible) --------------------
early9 1 def early9 (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a]]])
column3: macros are define-before-USE

column1: macro [[x y]]
column3: the definer needs [[params] [body]]

column1: macro []
column3: …and an empty spec list is no better

column1: macro [[] [quote [1]]]
column3: a macro needs at least one parameter — 0-operand macros are rejected

column1: def m (macro [[a b] [quote [unquote a]]]) m 1
column3: too few operands at expansion

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) typeof (tw2)
column3: a macro name is claimed at expansion — 0 operands is an arity error

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [splice a]]]) m 7
column3: splice of a non-list operand

column1: def spr (macro [[xs] [quote [splice xs]]]) spr ([4 5])
column3: a paren operand is a paren FORM — splice needs a list value

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [splice nosuch]]]) m 7
column3: splice of an unbound name inside the template

column1: # --- §6 macros are values built from fn parts -----------------------------
typeof (macro [[a] [quote [1]]])
column3: a macro VALUE is a Function until installed by def

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a]]]) m 41
column3: the identity macro

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a]]]) m {a:1}
column3: a map operand form rides through unquote

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a]]]) m "s"
column3: a string operand form rides through unquote

column1: def m (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a]]]) typeof (m 5)
column3: a macro call site types as its expansion's result

column1: def exp3 (macro [[a] [quote [unquote a add 2]]]) exp3 1 exp3 1 add
column3: each call site expands independently

column1: def cinq (macro [[a] [quote [5]]]) [cinq 1 cinq 2] size
column3: expansion inside a list literal, per occurrence

column1: def cinq (macro [[a] [quote [5]]]) {a: (cinq 0)}
column3: a macro call expands inside a map's paren value

column1: def unless2 (macro [[c body] [quote [if unquote c [0] unquote body]]]) unless2 false [4 add 3]
column3: a control-form macro: the generated if runs the body arm

column1: def unless2 (macro [[c body] [quote [if unquote c [0] unquote body]]]) unless2 (1 gt 2) [4 add 3]
column3: …with a paren condition evaluated inside the generated code

column1: def tw2 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) def app fn [[n:Integer][Integer][tw2 n]] app 7
column3: a macro used in a fn body expands at CALL time

column1: def app fn [[n:Integer][Integer][tw3 n]] def tw3 (macro [[e] [quote [unquote e add unquote e]]]) app 7
column3: …so the macro may be defined after the fn, before the call
